subject: design/existing-repo-onboarding-v2
statement: undo **removes the installation and preserves post-adoption work** (`brainstorm:existing-repo-onboarding#D-11`; `prd:existing-repo-onboarding/FR-9`). It unchains the hook (restoring `hooks.prior_hooks_path`), deletes the paths in `added_paths`, clears `epoch.commit`, and **names the plan's `collide-manual` entries for the human to reverse** — symmetric to adopt emitting them, since adoption never touched those owned files (`prd:existing-repo-onboarding/FR-9`; PRD §4.4) — leaving every post-adoption commit and edit in place. It **fails closed on operator edits**: a path in `added_paths` the operator has modified since adoption (a chained-hook wrapper, an added file) is **preserved and named, never deleted** (DINV-5; `prd:existing-repo-onboarding/UB-6`) — undo completes the rest of the removal and reports the preserved path.
